seo.title: Salesforce: Agentforce on its own funnel - 4.3 million inquiries resolved and $130M in pipeline (2026)
seo.meta_description: Salesforce runs Agentforce on its own channels: 4.3 million inquiries handled on help.salesforce.com (70% resolved) and $130M in pipeline identified autonomously.
seo.resume_citable: Salesforce uses its own Agentforce agent on help.salesforce.com (4.3 million inquiries, 70% resolved) and on its inbound funnel, where it identified 130 million dollars in pipeline autonomously.

faq.q: How does Salesforce use Agentforce for its own growth?
faq.a: On help.salesforce.com to resolve support inquiries without a human, and on its website to qualify inbound leads and generate sales pipeline.

faq.q: What quantified results does Salesforce claim?
faq.a: 4.3 million inquiries handled on its help portal with 70% resolution, and 130 million dollars in pipeline identified autonomously by its internal agents.

pattern: genAI agent deployed in-house on its own funnel (inbound lead qualification and self-service support)
objectif_business: Run its own growth with its own product. Salesforce uses Agentforce on its web properties to qualify inbound leads and generate pipeline, and on help.salesforce.com to resolve support inquiries without a human, publicly dogfooding the technology it sells.
points_cles: Agentforce genAI agent deployed in-house on support (help.salesforce.com) and inbound lead qualification.
Agentforce stack plus Data Cloud and RAG on the knowledge base, with a human in the loop.
4.3 million inquiries handled on the portal (70% resolved), $130M in pipeline identified autonomously.
description: Salesforce put Agentforce into production on its own channels. On help.salesforce.com, the agent handles help inquiries and resolves a large share of cases end to end, on a portal that sees about 60 million sessions and more than 2 million support cases per year. In parallel, a qualification agent (SDR / Engagement Agent) works inbound leads: it engages contacts, creates opportunities, and feeds the sales pipeline, first under human supervision and then autonomously with a human in the loop. Salesforce communicates these figures as proof of real use of its own product.

resultats.metrique: Pipeline identified autonomously by the Agentforce agents internally
About 4M over 15 months, double the human support volume

niveau_preuve.justification: The portal figures (4.3 million inquiries, 70% resolved) appear in an official Salesforce release, and the internal pipeline figures are attributed by name to the CMO of Agentforce Applications. Aligned sources, official release plus trade press, with exec confirmation on earnings.

stack_technique.detail: Salesforce's LLM agent platform, deployed in-house for support (help.salesforce.com) and inbound lead qualification.
Data layer that connects the agent to the contact's CRM history.
Retrieval-augmented generation over the product knowledge base; without an up-to-date KB, the resolution rate drops.
Creation of opportunities and tracking of the pipeline generated by the agents (SDR / Engagement Agent).

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time on each interaction (support chat, inbound visitor), with human supervision on high-stakes leads
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Salesforce's support and revenue operations teams, on the Agentforce platform connected to Data Cloud
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The product knowledge base and the contact's CRM history. Without an up-to-date knowledge base and clean CRM data, the agent hallucinates or misqualifies, and the resolution rate drops.

etapes.detail: The agent identifies whether the visitor is seeking support, product information, or is a lead to qualify.
It responds by drawing on the knowledge base and CRM data via RAG, on help.salesforce.com or on the site.
For a lead, the agent engages, qualifies, and creates the opportunity in the CRM.
Complex or high-stakes cases are routed to an SDR or a human support agent.
Resolution rate, pipeline generated, and conversion are tracked to adjust the agent's prompts and scope.

prerequis_orga: governance of prompts and agent scope
stack_possible: an agent platform (Agentforce, Copilot Studio, in-house agent)
a RAG engine over the knowledge base
replication.premiere_etape: Connect an agent to an up-to-date knowledge base and a narrow scope of inquiries, with a human in the loop.

playbook.action: Clean up the product knowledge base and define the scope of inquiries covered and excluded by the agent.
playbook.livrable: Up-to-date KB and a validated list of covered cases.

playbook.action: Configure the agent (support or lead qualification) with a human in the loop and escalation rules to SDR / support.
playbook.livrable: Agent in pre-production on a single channel.

playbook.action: Launch a pilot on limited real traffic and measure resolution rate, qualified leads, and pipeline created.
Broaden the scope and degree of autonomy based on observed quality, keeping supervision on high-stakes cases.
playbook.livrable: Agent in production with documented supervision rules.

replication.equipe: 1 Salesforce admin/dev + 1 revenue operations or support lead + 1 content owner for the knowledge base.

statut_vivant.note: Agentforce is a commercial and communications pillar for Salesforce (more than one billion dollars of Agentforce ARR announced). The dogfooding on help.salesforce.com and on the inbound funnel is highlighted repeatedly in 2025-2026 communications.

transposable_ue.note: The agent handles requests from authenticated users and inbound leads. In the EU, a legal basis and GDPR information are required for processing contact and support data; the AI Act mandates transparency about interacting with an automated system (the user must know they are talking to an agent). No high-risk classification for support and lead qualification.
